comparison.objective: Recharge a spring wound-drain reservoir by compressing it and sealing its plug; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop, then verifies motion.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained compression while inserting a plug differs from coaxial driver-and-wrench countertorque that preserves an angular adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Reservoir compressed and plugged versus locked 90° stop retained through three released cycles.
comparison.reason: Only generic bimanual holding is shared; the mechanisms and tested outcomes differ.
